messages:
maria: FYI incoming ticket from AcmeCorp — embeddings throughput dropped ~4x around 03:00 UTC. They say tokens/sec stayed about the same but vectors/sec tanked. Also intermittent 401s and a handful of billing errors. attaching their sample request/response.

samir: can you paste the request_id they gave? also which model variant they hit (open-embedder-v1 vs v2)?

maria: req_id=req_1a2b3c, model=open-embedder-v2. customer attached one failed response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "data": [],
  "meta": {"vectors_per_second": 1120, "tokens_per_second": 178000}
}
```
and a 401 stack: 
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"billing: account not active for embeddings"}
```

jessica: quick checks from infra — around 02:58–03:10 UTC we had a spike in embed queue depth on shard s-7 (queue depth ~1,200). GPU utilization on that shard jumped to 94% with tail latency spikes. I see a bunch of small requests from a single customer IP cluster (lots of retries).

zach: interesting — tokens/sec stable but vectors/sec down suggests the tokenization path is fine and the vector generation path is slower or doing smaller inefficient batches. Do we have per-request batch sizes/avg batch window for that shard?

jessica: pulling metrics now. snippet: 
```
03:00: gpu_util_pct s-7: 94.1
03:00: avg_batch_size s-7: 3.6 (baseline 18.4)
03:00: queue_depth s-7: 1187
03:00: embed_vecs_per_sec s-7: 1100 -> baseline 4600
03:00: tokens_per_sec s-7: 176k -> baseline 180k
```

samir: avg_batch_size that low explains vectors/sec drop. Why were we seeing tiny batches? customer retries/401s can cause clients to retry single-item requests which fragment batching. Does billing-bot show any changes to billing checks during that window?

billing-bot: Billing service logged a transient rate-limited response at 02:59:57 UTC for 0.04% of embedding auth checks — upstream payment gateway had a brief outage and returned 503s. We retried those checks which caused auth path to slow and some requests to be rejected (401) while clients retried.

samir: so sequence: payment gateway partial outage -> billing service returned 503/slow -> some token checks turned into 401/429 -> clients retried -> many small requests hitting embed runtime -> batching efficiency collapsed -> vectors/sec dropped but tokenization remained unchanged. that fits.

maria: customer is seeing both 401s and throughput drop; they're worried it's our runtime. want an explanation and repro steps.

zach: propose we give repro steps and mitigation: (a) reproduce by running high rate of small single-item requests with intermittent 401 from auth to force retries; (b) check that increasing batch window recovers vectors/sec; (c) short-term mitigation — ask customer to enable exponential backoff on client retries and/or bump max_batch_window_ms temporarily on their routing config.

samir: quick repro script (node) — send 800 rps single-item requests and simulate auth failures for 5% of requests: 
```
for i in range(0,800):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -d '{"input":"test"}' &
# observe avg_batch_size via /metrics
```

jessica: ops notes — to mitigate on our side we throttled retries in the auth path and increased batching window on s-7 from 20ms -> 60ms; that recovered avg_batch_size to ~14 and vectors/sec climbed back to ~4100 over ~3 minutes. No deploy required, just config toggle.

deploy-bot: config-change: shard.s-7.batching.window_ms: 20 -> 60 (by jessica) — rollout 03:12 UTC — success.

maria: passing this to Acme with timeline and recommended client fixes (exponential backoff + prefer bulk requests). also noted they can pin to open-embedder-v1 (smaller bundles) while we finish full postmortem.

zach: follow-ups: 1) telemetry: add metric to correlate auth failures -> avg_batch_size degradation, 2) product: consider circuit-breaker on auth retries so client-side retries don't fragment server batching, 3) support: create a KB article with recommended retry/backoff patterns for embeddings.

samir: adding one more operational tip — if a customer sees vectors/sec << tokens/sec, check avg_batch_size and queue_depth first; if avg_batch_size << baseline it's almost always batching fragmentation (retries, small payloads, or client SDK changed).

maria: thanks all — AcmeCorp acknowledged and will try SDK backoff patch. I'll keep thread open until they confirm recovery.

zach: saving the diagnostic graphs and req_1a2b3c trace to the ticket. Marking this as support->investigating for now. :thumbsup:
